title: Volume of a Parabolic Prism via Reordered Triple Integration
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume of the solid bounded by z = x^2, z = 4, y = 0, and y = 3.

steps.title: Identify Boundaries and Projection
steps.explanation: Express the symmetric x-limits in terms of z.

steps.title: Integrate with Respect to x
steps.explanation: The x-width at height z is 2 sqrt(z).

steps.title: Integrate over y and z
steps.explanation: Multiply length in y by the area of the parabolic cross-section in xz.
